catalog.name: _agent_output_receipts
catalog.sql:
CREATE TABLE _agent_output_receipts (
 receipt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL DEFAULT (lower(hex(randomblob(16)))),
 org_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(trim(org_id)<>''),
 project_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK(project_id=''),
 run_id TEXT,
 output_id TEXT,
 row_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'output',
 entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,
 learning_ids TEXT NOT NULL,
 delivery_owner TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'receipt',
 delivery_state TEXT NOT NULL,
 delivery_key TEXT,
 delivery_facts TEXT,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')),
 FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES _agent_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 CHECK(length(receipt_id)=32 AND receipt_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
 CHECK(reflexio_valid_publication_receipt(row_kind,entity_type,learning_ids,delivery_state,delivery_facts)=1),
 CHECK(
  (row_kind='output' AND delivery_owner='receipt' AND delivery_key IS NULL AND
    ((run_id IS NULL AND output_id IS NULL) OR
     (run_id IS NOT NULL AND output_id IS NOT NULL AND length(output_id)=32 AND output_id NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')))
  OR
  (row_kind='window_handoff' AND run_id IS NULL AND output_id IS NULL AND delivery_owner='receipt' AND delivery_key IS NOT NULL AND trim(delivery_key)<>''))
)

catalog.name: offline_tuner_open_world_invocations
catalog.sql:
CREATE TABLE offline_tuner_open_world_invocations (
    analyst_input_identity TEXT PRIMARY KEY
        CHECK (length(analyst_input_identity) = 64 AND analyst_input_identity NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    job_id INTEGER NOT NULL
        REFERENCES playbook_optimization_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    component_identity_digest TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (length(component_identity_digest) = 64 AND component_identity_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    expected_provider TEXT NOT NULL,
    expected_model_revision TEXT NOT NULL,
    input_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(input_digest) = 64 AND input_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    component_role TEXT NOT NULL,
    manifest_role TEXT,
    user_id TEXT,
    session_id TEXT,
    state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'prepared',
    output_json TEXT,
    output_digest TEXT,
    observed_provider TEXT,
    observed_model_revision TEXT,
    called_at INTEGER,
    latency_ms INTEGER,
    usage_json TEXT,
    prepared_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    completed_at INTEGER,
    qualification_result_digest TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (length(qualification_result_digest) = 64 AND qualification_result_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    trajectory_digest TEXT,
    candidate_artifact_digest TEXT,
    candidate_analyst_input_identity TEXT,
    CHECK (
        (component_role IN ('discovery', 'candidate', 'trigger_gate', 'trigger_builder') AND manifest_role IS NULL
         AND user_id IS NULL AND session_id IS NULL
         AND trajectory_digest IS NULL AND candidate_artifact_digest IS NULL
         AND candidate_analyst_input_identity IS NULL)
        OR (component_role = 'discovery' AND manifest_role = 'discovery'
         AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND session_id IS NOT NULL
         AND (length(trajectory_digest) = 64 AND trajectory_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')
         AND candidate_artifact_digest IS NULL
         AND candidate_analyst_input_identity IS NULL)
        OR (component_role = 'held_out'
         AND manifest_role IN ('held_out', 'safety_only')
         AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND session_id IS NOT NULL
         AND (length(trajectory_digest) = 64 AND trajectory_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')
         AND (length(candidate_artifact_digest) = 64 AND candidate_artifact_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')
         AND (length(candidate_analyst_input_identity) = 64 AND candidate_analyst_input_identity NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'))
    ),
    CHECK (
        (state = 'prepared' AND output_json IS NULL AND output_digest IS NULL
         AND observed_provider IS NULL AND observed_model_revision IS NULL
         AND called_at IS NULL AND latency_ms IS NULL AND usage_json IS NULL
         AND completed_at IS NULL)
        OR (state = 'completed' AND output_json IS NOT NULL
         AND (length(output_digest) = 64 AND output_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')
         AND observed_provider IS NOT NULL AND observed_model_revision IS NOT NULL
         AND called_at IS NOT NULL AND latency_ms >= 0 AND completed_at IS NOT NULL)
    )
)

catalog.sql:
CREATE TABLE offline_tuner_open_world_qualification_authority (
    singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (singleton = 1),
    epoch INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (epoch > 0),
    state TEXT NOT NULL,
    authority_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(authority_digest) = 64 AND authority_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    discovery_component_identity_digest TEXT,
    discovery_qualification_suite_digest TEXT,
    discovery_qualification_result_digest TEXT,
    held_out_component_identity_digest TEXT,
    held_out_qualification_suite_digest TEXT,
    held_out_qualification_result_digest TEXT,
    candidate_generator_identity_digest TEXT,
    candidate_generator_authorization_digest TEXT,
    unavailable_reason TEXT,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (updated_at >= 0),
    method_authority_json TEXT,
    CHECK (
        (state = 'active' AND unavailable_reason IS NULL
         AND (length(discovery_component_identity_digest) = 64 AND discovery_component_identity_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')
         AND (length(discovery_qualification_suite_digest) = 64 AND discovery_qualification_suite_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')
         AND (length(discovery_qualification_result_digest) = 64 AND discovery_qualification_result_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')
         AND (length(candidate_generator_identity_digest) = 64 AND candidate_generator_identity_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')
         AND (length(candidate_generator_authorization_digest) = 64 AND candidate_generator_authorization_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')
         AND method_authority_json IS NOT NULL
         AND held_out_component_identity_digest IS NULL
         AND held_out_qualification_suite_digest IS NULL
         AND held_out_qualification_result_digest IS NULL)
        OR (state = 'unavailable' AND trim(unavailable_reason) != ''
         AND discovery_component_identity_digest IS NULL
         AND discovery_qualification_suite_digest IS NULL
         AND discovery_qualification_result_digest IS NULL
         AND held_out_component_identity_digest IS NULL
         AND held_out_qualification_suite_digest IS NULL
         AND held_out_qualification_result_digest IS NULL
         AND candidate_generator_identity_digest IS NULL

    -- The displaced inferred outcome, kept whole. On the row rather than in a

    -- NULL = the whole session: a customer report or a legacy inferred row.

    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, session_id)
)

CREATE TABLE user_playbook_deployment_lifecycles (
    deployment_lifecycle_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    job_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE
        REFERENCES playbook_optimization_jobs(job_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'confirmed'
        CHECK (state IN ('confirmed', 'displaced', 'erased', 'provisional', 'restored')
               AND state != 'provisional'),
    predecessor_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (predecessor_id > 0),
    successor_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (successor_id > 0),
    predecessor_full_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (length(predecessor_full_fingerprint) = 64 AND predecessor_full_fingerprint NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    successor_full_fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (length(successor_full_fingerprint) = 64 AND successor_full_fingerprint NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    predecessor_projection_digest TEXT CHECK (
        predecessor_projection_digest IS NULL
        OR (length(predecessor_projection_digest) = 64 AND predecessor_projection_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')
    ),
    successor_projection_digest TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (length(successor_projection_digest) = 64 AND successor_projection_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    evidence_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(evidence_digest) = 64 AND evidence_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    candidate_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(candidate_digest) = 64 AND candidate_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    proof_digest TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(proof_digest) = 64 AND proof_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    qualification_authority_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL
        CHECK (qualification_authority_epoch > 0),
    qualification_authority_digest TEXT NOT NULL
        CHECK (length(qualification_authority_digest) = 64 AND qualification_authority_digest NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'),
    governance_epochs_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trim(governance_epochs_json) != ''),
    published_at INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (published_at >= 0),
    observation_deadline INTEGER NOT NULL,
    terminal_reason TEXT CHECK (
        terminal_reason IS NULL OR terminal_reason IN (
            'analyst_unqualified', 'confirmation_capability_invalidated', 'confirmed_online_support', 'governance_invalidated', 'governed_erasure', 'insufficient_online_support', 'observed_regression', 'published_unconditional', 'stale_incumbent', 'tuner_disabled'
        )
    ),
    terminal_at INTEGER,
    aggregation_obligation TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_confirmation'
        CHECK (aggregation_obligation IN
               ('pending_confirmation', 'enqueued', 'not_required')),
    CHECK (predecessor_id != successor_id),
    CHECK (observation_deadline = published_at + 1209600),
    CHECK (
        (state = 'provisional' AND terminal_reason IS NULL AND terminal_at IS NULL)
        OR (state != 'provisional' AND trim(terminal_reason) != ''
            AND terminal_at >= published_at)
    )
)

 WHERE agent_version=OLD.agent_version AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM playbook_aggregation_operations

 );

 completed_at=unixepoch(),updated_at=unixepoch(),next_attempt_at=NULL

END

CREATE TRIGGER publication_receipt_insert_guard
 BEFORE INSERT ON _agent_output_receipts BEGIN
  -- SQLite REPLACE can skip DELETE triggers when recursive_triggers is off.
  -- Refuse identity conflicts before its implicit deletion instead of relying
  -- on a connection-wide recursive-trigger mode.
  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM _agent_output_receipts q
    WHERE q.receipt_id=NEW.receipt_id
      OR (q.row_kind='output' AND NEW.row_kind='output' AND q.org_id=NEW.org_id
        AND q.run_id=NEW.run_id AND q.output_id=NEW.output_id)
      OR (q.row_kind='window_handoff' AND NEW.row_kind='window_handoff'
        AND q.org_id=NEW.org_id AND q.project_id=NEW.project_id AND q.delivery_key=NEW.delivery_key)
  ) THEN RAISE(ABORT,'publication receipt identity already exists') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.row_kind='legacy' THEN RAISE(ABORT,'historical receipt insertion is retired') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.row_kind='output' AND
   (NEW.run_id IS NULL OR NEW.output_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM _agent_runs r WHERE r.id=NEW.run_id AND r.org_id=NEW.org_id
      AND r.status IN ('agent_completed','finalizing')
      AND json_extract(r.committed_output,'$.publication.id')=NEW.output_id
      AND ((r.extractor_kind='profile' AND NEW.entity_type='profile') OR
           (r.extractor_kind='playbook' AND NEW.entity_type='user_playbook'))))
   THEN RAISE(ABORT,'publication output binding changed') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.row_kind='output' AND
    ((json_array_length(NEW.learning_ids)=0 AND NEW.delivery_state<>'accepted') OR
     (json_array_length(NEW.learning_ids)>0 AND NEW.delivery_state<>'pending'))
   THEN RAISE(ABORT,'new publication delivery state invalid') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.row_kind='window_handoff' AND NEW.delivery_state<>'pending'
   THEN RAISE(ABORT,'new window handoff must remain pending') END;
 END

BEFORE DELETE ON agent_playbooks
BEGIN
    UPDATE playbook_aggregation_item
    SET disposition = 'residual', cluster_id = NULL,
        reason = 'agent_playbook_deleted', attempt_count = 0,
        last_attempt_at = NULL, updated_at = unixepoch()
    WHERE cluster_id IN (
        SELECT cluster_id FROM playbook_aggregation_cluster
        WHERE agent_playbook_id = OLD.agent_playbook_id
    );
    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO playbook_aggregation_state(
        agent_version, pending, next_attempt_at
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT agent_version, 1, unixepoch()
    FROM playbook_aggregation_cluster
    WHERE agent_playbook_id = OLD.agent_playbook_id;
    UPDATE playbook_aggregation_state
    SET pending = 1
    WHERE agent_version IN (
        SELECT agent_version FROM playbook_aggregation_cluster
        WHERE agent_playbook_id = OLD.agent_playbook_id
    );
    DELETE FROM playbook_aggregation_cluster
    WHERE agent_playbook_id = OLD.agent_playbook_id;
END
